analyst_view.overall: Santa Clara (21 pts after 10 games, 15 scored, 6 conceded) are in the top four and won 2-0 at Marítimo last Sunday. Gil Vicente (7th, 15 pts) have scored only 8 and conceded 7 in 10 league games, and drew 0-0 with Guimarães last time out. The last two meetings both ended 1-0. Diogo Rosa referees.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.9 goals, and the news points lower still. Both defences are among the league's tightest, Gil Vicente average under a goal a game in attack, and both of last season's meetings finished 1-0. One lineup preview says Santa Clara have named the same XI three games running, so their solid shape should stay intact.
